entities.name: Q7NCQ1 RsmH
observations: Reviewed Gloeobacter violaceus RsmH; query sequence is an exact full-length 314-aa match (100% identity and coverage).
Methylates cytidine N4 at position 1402 of 16S rRNA; EC 2.1.1.199.
Reference annotation places the protein in the cytoplasm and associates it with rRNA cytosine-N4-methyltransferase activity and rRNA base methylation.
Sequence-derived estimates: 35,211 Da, pI 6.74, GRAVY -0.396; estimates do not account for modifications or complexes.

entities.name: 16S rRNA C1402 methylation
observations: Reaction: cytidine(1402) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine -> N4-methylcytidine(1402) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+; Rhea RHEA:42928.
